description: This file defines the WrongAssignmentReportService class, which handles reporting wrong assignment issues in bookings, listing reports, and sending related webhooks. It interacts with repositories, external webhooks, and error handling modules.

classes.name: WrongAssignmentReportService
classes.description: Service class for handling wrong assignment reports, including reporting, listing, and webhook notifications.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Handles creating a new wrong assignment report, including validation, database insertion, and webhook notification.

methods.name: listReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of wrong assignment reports based on team, status, and other filters.

methods.name: sendWebhooks
methods.description: Sends webhook notifications related to a wrong assignment report, including error handling and logging.
